1 (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; __wherein the elongated device is inserted between tissue layers within the brain__ to create a working channel along the path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path.

2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a __therapeutic instrument__.

4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __to access the brain tissue__.

5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising __inserting the elongated device into the brain tissue__ between tissue layers.

7 (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; __wherein the elongated device is reinforced against the tissue during expansion__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device __within the tissue between layers__.

12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound __to enhance clotting and reduce bleeding__.

13 (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __to facilitate the procedure__.

16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __to enhance access to the treatment site__.
